title: Bridgewell New Home Builder Warranties — Setting the Phase End Dates at Enrollment
content:
**Clause.** Under Bridgewell's New Home Builder Warranties, the phase end dates of a warranty are set at enrollment: the workmanship end date is the day before the workmanship-years anniversary of the closing date, the systems end date the day before the systems-years anniversary and the structural end date the day before the structural-years anniversary, a 29 February anniversary falling back to 28 February.

The number of years for each phase is the program's workmanship, systems and structural term, counted from the closing date. A structural-only warranty, which has no workmanship or systems term, carries no workmanship or systems end date; only its structural end date is set.

## The three dates

| End date | Anniversary it is measured from | End date is |
|---|---|---|
| Workmanship end date | The closing date's anniversary after the program's workmanship years | The day before that anniversary |
| Systems end date | The closing date's anniversary after the program's systems years | The day before that anniversary |
| Structural end date | The closing date's anniversary after the program's structural years | The day before that anniversary |

## Worked dates (hypothetical closing dates)

**Closing date 15 May 2025, on a program with 1 workmanship year, 2 systems years and 10 structural years.**

- Workmanship: the 1-year anniversary is 15 May 2026; the workmanship end date is 14 May 2026.
- Systems: the 2-year anniversary is 15 May 2027; the systems end date is 14 May 2027.
- Structural: the 10-year anniversary is 15 May 2035; the structural end date is 14 May 2035.

**Closing date 1 March 2026, on a program with 2 workmanship years, 4 systems years and 10 structural years.**

- Workmanship: the 2-year anniversary is 1 March 2028; the workmanship end date is 29 February 2028, 2028 being a leap year.
- Systems: the 4-year anniversary is 1 March 2030; the systems end date is 28 February 2030.
- Structural: the 10-year anniversary is 1 March 2036; the structural end date is 29 February 2036.

**Closing date 3 September 2025, on a structural-only program of 10 structural years.** No workmanship or systems end date is set; the structural end date is 2 September 2035.

## Points of judgement

- Each end date is the last day of its phase: the phase runs through that date inclusive.
- The dates are set at enrollment, from the closing date of the sale.
